narration_updates.old_key: f"How much does the better guess buy?
narration_updates.key: f"How much does the better guess buy? A star on the eight-puzzle, a hundred positions per solution length. <bookmark mark='a'/> With no heuristic, at length {dd}, it expands {last['astar_h0']:,.0f} states on average. <bookmark mark='b'/> Counting misplaced tiles: {last['astar_h1']:,.0f}. <bookmark mark='c'/> The Manhattan distance: {last['astar_h2']:,.0f}. <bookmark mark='d'/> The effective branching factor, the branching of a uniform tree of the same size and depth, falls from {ebf['astar_h0']:.2f} to {ebf['astar_h1']:.2f} to {ebf['astar_h2']:.2f}: each step toward one is an exponential saving. <bookmark mark='e'/> The Manhattan distance is never below the misplaced count. For consistent heuristics, dominance cannot increase the states with f below the optimal cost that A star must expand. At the boundary, equal f values and tie breaking can change the total."

narration_updates.zh: 更好的猜测能换来多少？在八数码上运行A星，每种解长取100个局面。<bookmark mark='a'/>不用启发式时，在解长{dd}处，它平均扩展{last['astar_h0']:,.0f}个状态。<bookmark mark='b'/>数放错的方块：{last['astar_h1']:,.0f}个。<bookmark mark='c'/>曼哈顿距离：{last['astar_h2']:,.0f}个。<bookmark mark='d'/>有效分支因子，也就是同样大小、同样深度的均匀树的分支数，从{ebf['astar_h0']:.2f}降到{ebf['astar_h1']:.2f}，再降到{ebf['astar_h2']:.2f}：每向1靠近一步，都是指数级的节省。<bookmark mark='e'/>曼哈顿距离从不小于放错的方块数。对一致的启发式，占优关系不会增加A星必须扩展的、f小于最优代价的状态。在边界上，相同的f值及其平局处理方式会改变总扩展数。

narration_updates.old_key: In 1965 Alan Robinson gave machines a single rule of inference
narration_updates.key: In 1965 Alan Robinson gave machines a resolution rule for automated deduction. <bookmark mark='a'/> Write every fact as a clause, an or of literals. If one clause contains x and another not x, resolve them: at least one of the rest must hold. <bookmark mark='b'/> To prove a goal, add its negation, here: the grass is not wet, <bookmark mark='c'/> and resolve until you derive the empty clause, a contradiction. <bookmark mark='d'/> Not wet and the rain rule give no rain; not wet and the sprinkler rule give no sprinkler; rain or sprinkler, with no sprinkler, gives rain; rain against no rain leaves nothing. <bookmark mark='e'/> Robinson proved the method sound and refutation-complete. First-order clauses also need factoring: unify same-sign literals within one clause. Without a resource cap, resolution and factoring can derive the empty clause whenever the clauses are inconsistent. Our bounded run can stop without an answer.
narration_updates.english_source: In 1965 Alan Robinson gave machines a resolution rule for automated deduction. <bookmark mark='a'/> Write every fact as a clause, an or of literals. If one clause contains x and another not x, resolve them: at least one of the rest must hold. <bookmark mark='b'/> To prove a goal, add its negation, here: the grass is not wet, <bookmark mark='c'/> and resolve until you derive the empty clause, a contradiction. <bookmark mark='d'/> Not wet and the rain rule give no rain; not wet and the sprinkler rule give no sprinkler; rain or sprinkler, with no sprinkler, gives rain; rain against no rain leaves nothing. <bookmark mark='e'/> Robinson proved the method sound and refutation-complete. First-order clauses also need factoring: unify same-sign literals within one clause. Without a resource cap, resolution and factoring can derive the empty clause whenever the clauses are inconsistent. Our bounded run can stop without an answer.
narration_updates.zh: 1965年，艾伦·鲁滨逊给了机器一条用于自动演绎的归结规则。<bookmark mark='a'/>把每条事实写成一个子句，也就是若干文字的“或”。如果一个子句含有x，另一个含有非x，就把它们归结：剩下的部分至少有一个必须成立。<bookmark mark='b'/>要证明一个目标，就加入它的否定，这里是：草地不湿，<bookmark mark='c'/>然后不断归结，直到推出空子句，也就是一个矛盾。<bookmark mark='d'/>不湿和下雨那条规则，得到不下雨；不湿和洒水器那条规则，得到洒水器没开；下雨或洒水器，加上洒水器没开，得到下雨；下雨对上不下雨，什么都不剩。<bookmark mark='e'/>鲁滨逊证明这个方法是可靠的，而且是反驳完备的。一阶子句还需要因子化：合一同一子句内同号的文字。不加资源上限时，只要子句集不一致，归结与因子化就能推出空子句。我们有资源上限的运行，也可能没有得到答案就停止。
